steps.content: [Scene] Outside the Venue

The sun is relentless during Eastside's summer. The streets are scorching, and the asphalt has gone soft underfoot. Meanwhile, rising heat warps the grand stadium in the distance into a shimmering mirage.
A massive poster of Phanuel still hangs on the outer wall, its edges curling in the heat. The concert was days ago, but with the investigation still ongoing, nobody has taken any of it down.
Beneath the poster, two groups have gathered since morning, shouting all day long.

steps.speaker: Justice Fan
steps.content: Punish the corrupt idol Phanuel! Justice for the Hollow Syndrome victims!

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: Phanuel is innocent! Mirrormoon Entertainment is the real villain!

A security guard drafted in as backup leans his shield against the fence and shuffles half a step into the shade by the wall. A janitor walks over with a broom, sets her dustpan on the ground, and the two of them strike up a conversation.

steps.speaker: Janitor Lady
steps.content: They're still at it? These kids sure are energetic.

steps.speaker: Security Guard
steps.content: Right? It's been four hours now. We've rotated shifts twice and they haven't even stopped to eat. The way things are going, they'll be at it till the sun's down.

steps.speaker: Justice Fan
steps.content: You're heartless, Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: Fly high, Phanuel! The Cherubs will follow you to the ends of the world!

On the left, someone's voice has become hoarse from screaming, cracking into a raspy squawk. The other side fires right back, and a few girls are crying so hard that the tears have left a few streaks on their makeup.
The janitor glances back and forth between the two sides.

The left side is an army of antis in black T-shirts. Loudspeakers, graffiti, meme stickers, black-and-white photos... they've pulled out every tool they can use to flame Phanuel. It's working too, seeing as the fans on the other side are absolutely fuming.

On the opposite side is an army of fans in pink T-shirts, light sticks raised high, passionately waving banners that read "The Angel Lives Forever, The Cherubs Shall Follow Evermore". They're crying and singing their cheers all at once.

steps.speaker: Janitor Lady
steps.content: ...So who's winning? I can't make heads or tails of it.

steps.speaker: Security Guard
steps.content: Their vocal cords are working overtime now, but neither side's convinced the other of anything. I've got no clue why they're even arguing to begin with. Hey, isn't that press conference starting soon?

A police line separates the two sides. Young officers from the Public Security Bureau stand along the barrier, sweat beading on their foreheads, shields half-raised, braced for the crowd to boil over at any moment.

steps.speaker: Justice Fan
steps.content: You people need help! Who even defends a maniac who sent a bunch of people into a coma?!

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: You're the ones who're crazy! Can't you see she was being used?!

As the argument escalates, someone on the left tries to break through, only to get pushed back by an officer. The right side immediately hurls a water bottle that smacks someone on the opposite side square in the back.

Flyers printed with bold slogans drift through the air, and once they hit the ground, they're quickly trampled underfoot, joining the empty water bottles and crushed cans as part of the growing pile of litter.

steps.speaker: Janitor Lady
steps.content: Oh dear, doesn't anyone feel bad for that pretty face? Can I sweep up those flyers?

steps.speaker: Security Guard
steps.content: Go ahead. Not like anyone's looking at them anyway.

The security guard grabs an agitated fan trying to cross the police line and shoves them back. Shouts and sobs, the hiss of walkie-talkies, the rapid-fire clicking of camera shutters—all of it churns together as a chaotic mess in the heat.
Reporters with cameras of every shape and size thrust their lenses into every contorted face they can find, while beyond the crowd, ordinary passersby look on with no idea what's happening.

The janitor picks up her broom and works her way through the gaps, sweeping the litter into a pile. She has no idea whether this <color=#fb9259>Phanuel</color> everyone keeps going on about has done something good or something terrible. All she wants is to finish sweeping so she can clock out on time.

steps.speaker: Janitor Lady
steps.content: Sigh... What a mess...
At the same time, a black sedan glides silently through the VIP entrance on the other side of the venue, unnoticed by anyone.
[Scene Change] Inside a vehicle
Phanuel presses herself against the car window, her nose nearly touching the glass. Lucky for her, it's one-way tinted. If those fans could see her, the car would be wrecked by now.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Posters of Phanuel... banners... and so many people. They all came for Phanuel.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Chief, is this where Phanuel held the concert that brought happiness to everyone?
She turns to look at you. The dazzling sunlight streams through the car window and gilds her face, illuminating that model smile. It's almost like a portrait in a museum has come to life.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't forget why we're here today. Are you ready, Phanuel?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I've read the statement ten times, as instructed. I've also rehearsed emotional cues at least five times. Would you like to check Phanuel's fake crying, Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you remember what your mission is?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Of course. Today, Phanuel's mission is to—
[Flashback] Phanuel's Room + Flashback Filter

MBCC Chief's Office
After the livestream

The livestream ends, but the public outcry doesn't. It simply moves underground, spilling into dark web forums, group chats, and every corner of the internet where people can speak without being watched.
Inside the Bureau, Phanuel stands obediently before the desk, like a grade-schooler waiting for her teacher's verdict.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Chief, how did I do today?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you think?
Phanuel blinks. The question isn't in her script, but she smiles and answers anyway.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I think... it went pretty well? I showed everyone a day in my life at the Bureau, just as you asked, and I didn't say anything I wasn't supposed to.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's true. You didn't say anything out of line. Though there were a few moments when your <color=#fb9259>real thoughts</color> slipped through.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Was... "I'll cooperate with the Bureau and accept their investigation" too fake? I just thought it might stop people from turning on the Bureau...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The idea was there.
You glance at the bandages wrapped around Phanuel's hand. She pulls it back nervously.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It's fine... as long as no one touches it. Compared to the pain everyone else went through, this is nothing.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...Do you think I'll ever get to go back on stage, Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Go back on stage?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Like... continuing to do something positive for everyone, or advertising the Bureau... things like that?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In other words, you want to be seen.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What's so wrong with that? Isn't being seen by everyone the whole reason Phanuel exists?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fair enough. Anything else?
You smile at Phanuel. She looks back at you, seemingly wanting to say something, yet the words are stuck in her throat. So you don't speak either.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Do you not have other orders for me, Chief?

Phanuel simply stands across from you, and doesn't move for a long while. She expected this conversation to end somewhere: exposed, reassured, warned... But nothing comes. It's like throwing a punch and hitting air.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I do have a mission that only you can handle, actually.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come with me tomorrow. It's a field mission.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'll make you proud, Chief!
Phanuel leaves the office, satisfied. You open your terminal and begin preparing for tomorrow's mission.
[Fade to Black] Cut back to the car

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you remember what your mission is?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Of course! Today's mission for Phanuel is to deliver a retirement statement and put the chaos to rest.
[Scene Change] Camera flashes, press conference venue

At the press conference venue, media representatives and fan delegates have already taken their positions. Cameras of every size are aimed squarely at the stage, lens caps off, as everyone waits for Phanuel to step out.

Public Security Bureau guards have been posted on either side of the stage, ready to hold back any fan who gets too worked up. You walk onto the stage as part of the accompanying staff and take a quick look at the crowd below.

Reporters in the press section are checking their voice recorders. Meanwhile, fans in the back rows are leaning forward for a better view. Then there's the Public Security Bureau officers, who are pulling the perimeter tape taut. You speak up, just clear enough to reach the very last row.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Phanuel will be reading a statement at today's press conference. Once she is done, she will be escorted back directly by MBCC. There will be no Q&A session.

steps.speaker: Reporter 1
steps.content: No Q&A? Then what are we even here for?

steps.speaker: Reporter 2
steps.content: You just don't get it. Grab a few juicy shots, slap one photo at the top, and you can make up whatever you want. The more sensational, the better.
You nod to the MBCC guards, signaling them to let her through. Every eye in the room is fixed on the curtain at the side of the stage.
[Camera Flash Effect]

The curtain parts. Guards close in around Phanuel and slowly escort her into the venue. The cameras erupt all at once, becoming a blinding sea of white. She, however, doesn't even blink, having long gotten used to it.
The moment Phanuel appears, fans surge forward in a frenzy, only to be held back by the wall of guards.

steps.speaker: Justice Fan
steps.content: Get out of the industry, Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: We'll be waiting for you, Phanuel!

The shouts of the two factions clash, neither drowning out the other. Phanuel doesn't look at either of them. She keeps her head down and walks onto the stage she hasn't stood on in a long time, one step at a time, and even takes a moment to smile at you.
She picks up the microphone and turns toward the angry fans, bowing deeply. Her back bends lower and lower, as if she might fold herself in two.
The venue, still ringing with jeers just moments ago, falls silent. Her presence alone has dissolved the crowd's anger. The banners in their hands grow heavy, slowly sinking toward the ground.

You glance down at the PR statement in your hand. This is the version the Bureau, the PR team, and Phanuel herself signed off on. Every sentence has been stripped down to the conclusion, nothing more.
Phanuel looks down at the same statement.
<i><color=#7683a2>"To all members of the media and my fans, hello. Thank you for being here today."</color><i>

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: To all members of the media and my Cherubs, hello. Thank you all... for coming to see me, even in this heat.
You look up. Didn't she say she'd read it over ten times? And she's gone off-script on the very first line?
<i><color=#7683a2>"Regarding the recent events and the harm caused to the general public, my fans, and the families of Hollow Syndrome patients, I sincerely apologize."</color><i>

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Regarding the recent events and the harm caused to the public, and to everyone here... I honestly don't know how I'd ever make things right.
You frown. Again, the first half follows the script, but she made up the second half. The focus has shifted from a formal apology to a promise of making amends.

<i><color=#7683a2>"The case is still under investigation, and it will take time for the truth to come to light. However, public discourse has strayed so far from the facts that I felt compelled to come forward and make a statement."</color><i>

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: The case is still under investigation, and it will take time for the truth to come to light. Though I've lost my memories, and can't provide any further leads...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I still felt like I needed to come forward and set an example for everyone who believes in me.
The first two deviations could still be chalked up to nerves, but this line makes it clear: Phanuel isn't stumbling over the words. She's deliberately rewriting the script.
But what is she trying to do?
<i><color=#7683a2>"I will permanently retire from the entertainment industry and will cooperate fully with the relevant authorities during the investigation."</color><i>

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel has decided... that I will no longer take the stage.

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: No! Phanuel! We still want to see you!

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: No, Phanuel! How am I supposed to go on without you?!
Phanuel's announcement sends the crowd into a frenzy. You speak into your earpiece, issuing a warning.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Phanuel, stick to the script.
No response. Clearly, she has completely forgotten your agreement. You keep a close watch on the situation, ready to deploy the shackles at a moment's notice.
<i><color=#7683a2>"Thank you all for your support. I also hope everyone will approach this matter rationally, and that no unnecessary conflict will arise from it."</color><i>

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I've heard your voices. Thank you so much for the love and support you've given Phanuel. I hope you'll all find happiness!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: So please, don't fight over Phanuel. Your love has reached me. Every last bit of it.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: To everyone who has ever cheered for Phanuel, everyone who has ever believed in Phanuel... you are proof that Phanuel has lived!
Phanuel's performance is flawless. Even the tears fall at precisely the right moment. One, then two, gently tracing two curves down her cheeks.

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: Phanuel! Don't cry! We'll always believe in you!
The statement has lost its purpose. You crumple it up and toss it in the trash.

steps.speaker: Justice Fan
steps.content: What's crying gonna do? Her tears aren't saving the victims!
Phanuel doesn't argue back. She simply bows her head, absorbing every word of the criticism. Her shoulders tremble faintly, but her bandaged hand still holds the microphone steady.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I know. Many people want me gone. And I will be.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But if someday, when you think of Phanuel... it makes you even just a little happy. That would be enough.
Phanuel manages a slight smile, as though even that costs her something. She is radiant under the stage lights. Angelic.

steps.speaker: Die-Hard Fan
steps.content: Phanuel, we just want you back!

steps.speaker: Justice Fan
steps.content: You're gonna forgive her, just like that?! Hey, stop pushing...

steps.speaker: Fans
steps.content:
Fly high, Phanuel! The Cherubs will follow you to the ends of the world! 
Fly high, Phanuel! The Cherubs will follow you to the ends of the world!
Phanuel has twisted the cold, calculated PR language into a genuine apology and confession. The restless pulse of Mania stirring through the venue confirms it: Phanuel is using her ability.

Somewhere along the way, the two factions in the crowd have merged into one. They gaze up at Phanuel with reverence, their emotions wholly in her grip, as the swelling tide of cheers slowly drowns out every voice of dissent.

She's effortlessly shifted the narrative from "Phanuel is guilty" to "Phanuel is a victim too." What was supposed to be a retirement press conference has become, in every sense, Phanuel's comeback tour.
You don't deserve this!
A furious roar cuts through the crowd's sobs. A figure radiating Mania breaks through the security line.
Their cap tumbles to the ground as they sprint forward, revealing a pair of bloodshot eyes, locked right on Phanuel. The sharp blade in their hand gleams coldly.
You don't deserve to be forgiven!
[Red Flash, Screen Shakes, Blood Effect]
The guards lunge forward, but they're half a step too late. The blade goes through the crowd, closing in on the stage.

Yet Phanuel doesn't move out of the way. She looks frightened, but it also looks as though she's been waiting for this very moment. The fragile smile at the corner of her lips hasn't faded. The tears are still on her face.
As the blade closes in, she shuts her eyes.
[Shackles Effect] Black Screen + Red Flash + Screen Shakes
Tears, a smile, vulnerability, anguish—every expression had been readied and waiting. But the pain that should have followed never came. So, she opens her eyes.

The dark crimson shackles have intercepted the attacker. The blade, however, still finds its mark, slicing through the sleeve of the gray figure. The tip punches through the fabric and into the flesh. Vivid red spatters across the hem of Phanuel's dress, dripping drop by drop onto the floor.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Ch-chief...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Crowd
steps.content: AAAHHH!
The venue erupts into chaos. The fans snap out of Phanuel's influence, screaming as they scramble for the exits.
I'll never forgive you! You destroyed my family!
The guards pin the attacker to the ground, but that doesn't stop his roaring. The reporters freeze for just a moment, then the camera flashes erupt all at once.
You turn sideways, using your injured shoulder to block the nearest camera lens, and with it, the shock on Phanuel's face that she hasn't had the chance to hide yet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did I ruin your plan, Phanuel?
The burst of camera flashes makes her pupils contract sharply, snapping her back to herself. She composes her expression almost instantly, and swiftly reaches over to steady your injured shoulder.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You're hurt, Chief. We need to get that bandaged right away...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You didn't move out of the way just now.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I just... the shackles held me in place. I couldn't move.
Phanuel didn't step back as the blade closed in. Her right shoulder shifted forward, just barely, a movement so slight that most wouldn't have noticed.
But not you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You leaned in.
The smile on Phanuel's face falters, just a little.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...I didn't.
You stare at her. Watch as she denies it out of habit, watch as she lies. In this moment, your silence weighs heavier than any accusation could.
The screams from the crowd, the camera shutters, the shouts of the guards all blur together. Amidst it all, she stands rooted to the spot, pinned there by your gaze.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That blade was supposed to be your perfect curtain call. Too bad it missed.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What are you talking about, Chief? Phanuel is really scared of pain, how could I...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's a lie. If you were, why would you hurt yourself during a livestream just to win sympathy?
Your accusation strikes Phanuel speechless. The smile she had been forcing just moments ago finally begins to slip.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You went off script from the very first line. I'm not sure what you were after, but I did think it'd be fine to let you have your say within reason. Until you scrapped the speech entirely, that is...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You don't actually care what happens to your fans, do you? You just enjoy the attention and the love they give you. Otherwise, why would you use your power on them again?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said you needed my orders, that you wouldn't know what to do otherwise. And yet, here you are, still fighting for yourself despite receiving none.
The noise of the crowd grows distant. Phanuel looks up at you, and for the first time, she's truly panicking. She realizes the ending she's written has been thrown completely off course.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel... didn't mean to...
She instinctively lets go of you and tries to step back, but you raise your injured hand to grab her wrist. Your grip is firm, leaving no opportunity for her to run.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't run, Phanuel.
Phanuel's thoughts are unravelling, to the point where she can't string together a sentence. She yanks her arm hard, trying to wrench herself free from your grip.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It's time... for Phanuel's curtain call, Chief... Let go...

The usual calmness in Phanuel's voice is gone. She struggles, desperate to get out from under the cameras. Your wound sends a sharp sting through your arm, but you don't let go. You pull her back in front of you, taking that same angle to block the camera lens.
It's only when she sees your wound bleeding again that Phanuel settles down.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Chief, your hand...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's exactly why I'm saying it now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All this time, I couldn't quite wrap my head around just what you're playing at. But I've got it now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><b>What you want... is a life where everything comes easily. Isn't that right?
She freezes. Her body's strength drains from her, and her clenched fist slowly uncurls, falling slack at her side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can abandon an identity. You can start over with new memories. But habits don't lie. You remembered to find the camera, to manage your expression, and every PR line and manipulation trick your manager ever taught you.
The blood soaks through the fabric and drips onto the floor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><b>You never actually lost your memory.
The words hit Phanuel like a physical blow. A shudder runs through her. Her mouth opens, but her voice doesn't come out. That perfect face, that fragile expression, all gone.
You step closer and lower your voice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And not just this time...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The last time you <color=#fb9259>reset your life</color>, too.
